witnesses.binary_domain: PredictionMarketP0.Result has NONE, YES_WIN, NO_WIN only; resolve(NONE) reverts BadState.
witnesses.complete_set: split(100) mints exactly 100 YES and 100 NO after exact physical collateral receipt.
witnesses.winner_redemption: At MAX_OUTCOME_SUPPLY, YES_WIN liability equals YES supply and redeemYes(max) pays exactly max without multiplication overflow.
witnesses.lifecycle_atomicity: Factory rejects collateral == resolver; callback routed through a separate resolver during split reverts with no state change and no minted outcomes.
witnesses.bounded_arithmetic: split(MAX_OUTCOME_SUPPLY) succeeds; additional split(1) and split(MAX_OUTCOME_SUPPLY + 1) reject before state change.

limitations: No Python semantic oracle or Python-to-Solidity differential fixture yet.
Collateral gate is not fully passed because physicalBalance >= liability has not been checked after every accepted transition under a stateful campaign.
This is a research kernel under research/contract-kernels, not production code.
